Chinese 敵烈八部 has no parenthetical gloss; '(idiomatic)' is a stray English artifact.
Under the 奧裏部 heading, 以與梅只，墮瑰三部 means Aoli together with Meizhi and Duigui; Zheli is invented and Mei truncates 梅只. Parallel 聖宗合奧裏、梅只、墮瑰三部為一 confirms the three names.
戍隗烏古部 is the Garrisoning Wei Wugu division; 'The Garrisoning the Wugu Wug' is ungrammatical and misreads 隗 as a repeated Wugu.
